title: FapServiceCredential
description: Credential of a machine client of the FAP IoT & AI: connector, NiFi, Spark, AI Processing. Held in the W-Stack credential storage of the owning organisation's tenant; exchanged for a short-lived Keycloak token, so no static secret is used on the data path. Uses the same roles and purposes vocabulary as FapIotAiRoleCredential. Draft 0.2.

id.description: Service DID, a path below the organisation's did:web, e.g. did:web:<tenant>.<domain>:services:<serviceName>.

org_did.description: DID of the organisation operating the service.

serviceName.description: Instance name, unique within the organisation (Kubernetes name rules).

roles.description: FAP roles granted to the service, from the same vocabulary as people.
